arxiv-2011-12829.title: All You Need is a Good Functional Prior for Bayesian Deep Learning
arxiv-2011-12829.creator: Ba-Hien Tran ba-hien.tran@eurecom.fr
arxiv-2011-12829.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Ba-Hien Tran ba-hien.tran@eurecom.fr. The Bayesian treatment of neural networks dictates that a prior distribution is specified over their weight and bias parameters. This poses a challenge because modern neural networks are characterized by a large number of parameters, and the choice of these priors has an uncontrolled effect on the induced functional prior, which is the distribution of the functions obtained by sampling the parameters from their prior distribution.

arxiv-2105-14810.title: Estimates of the order of approximation of functions of several variables in the generalized Lorentz space
arxiv-2105-14810.creator: G. Akishev
arxiv-2105-14810.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by G. Akishev. In this paper we consider X(\bar{\varphi}) anisotropic symmetric space 2\pi of periodic functions of m variables, in particular, the generalized Lorentz space L_{\bar{\psi},\bar{\tau}}^{*}(\mathbb{T}^{m}) and Nikol’skii–Besov’s class S_{X(\bar{\varphi}),\bar{\theta}}^{\bar{r}}B . The article proves an embedding theorem for the Nikol’skii - Besov class in the generalized Lorentz space and establishes an upper bound for the best approximations by trigonometric polynomials with harmonic numbers from the hyperbolic cross of functions from the class S_{X(\bar{\varphi}),\bar{\theta}}^{\bar{r}}B .

arxiv-2108-02492.title: Symplectic integration of learned Hamiltonian systems
arxiv-2108-02492.creator: C. Offen {}^{\hrefhttps://orcid.org/0000-0002-5940-8057}, S. Ober-Blöbaum
arxiv-2108-02492.description: Abstract Hamiltonian systems are differential equations which describe systems in classical mechanics, plasma physics, and sampling problems. They exhibit many structural properties, such as a lack of attractors and the presence of conservation laws. To predict Hamiltonian dynamics based on discrete trajectory observations, incorporation of prior knowledge about Hamiltonian structure greatly improves predictions.

arxiv-2204-02792.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Mikhail A. Ivanov a and Dmitri Melikhov a,b,c. The amplitude of the process is described by the same form factors as the amplitude of the B → ℓ ​ ℓ ​ ℓ ′ ​ ν ¯ ℓ ′ {B\to\ell\ell\ell^{\prime}\bar{\nu}^{\prime}_{\ell}} decay for non-identical leptons in the final state.

arxiv-2207-02452.title: Some recent results on singular p p -Laplacian systems
arxiv-2207-02452.creator: Umberto Guarnotta, Roberto Livrea
arxiv-2207-02452.description: Abstract Some recent existence, multiplicity, and uniqueness results for singular p p -Laplacian systems either in bounded domains or in the whole space are presented, with a special attention to the case of convective reactions. A extensive bibliography is also provided. Keywords: quasi-linear elliptic system, gradient dependence, singular term, entire solution, strong solution. AMS Subject Classification: 35-02, 35J62, 35J75, 35J92.

arxiv-2212-13391.title: Consistency of matter coupling in modified gravity
arxiv-2212-13391.creator: Kazufumi Takahashi, Rampei Kimura, Hayato Motohashi
arxiv-2212-13391.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Kazufumi Takahashi, Rampei Kimura, Hayato Motohashi. Matter coupling in modified gravity theories is a nontrivial issue when the gravitational Lagrangian possesses a degeneracy structure to avoid the problem of the Ostrogradsky ghost. Recently, this issue was addressed for bosonic matter fields in the generalized disformal Horndeski class, which is so far the most general class of ghost-free scalar-tensor theories obtained by performing a higher-derivative generalization of invertible disformal transformations on Horndeski theories.

arxiv-2305-06330.title: Korean Named Entity Recognition Based on Language-Specific Features
arxiv-2305-06330.creator: Yige Chen, KyungTae Lim, Jungyeul Park
arxiv-2305-06330.description: Abstract In the paper, we propose a novel way of improving named entity recognition in the Korean language using its language-specific features. While the field of named entity recognition has been studied extensively in recent years, the mechanism of efficiently recognizing named entities in Korean has hardly been explored.

arxiv-2305-07786.title: Rationalizing Euclidean Assemblies of Hard Polyhedra from Tessellations in Curved Space
arxiv-2305-07786.creator: Philipp W. A. Schönhöfer 1 , Kai Sun 2 , Xiaoming Mao 2 , and Sharon C. Glotzer 1,2,3
arxiv-2305-07786.description: Abstract Entropic self-assembly is governed by the shape of the constituent particles, yet a priori prediction of crystal structures from particle shape alone is non-trivial for anything but the simplest of space-filling shapes. At the same time, most polyhedra are not space filling due to geometric constraints, but these constraints can be relaxed or even eliminated by sufficiently curving space.

arxiv-2310-00356.title: Functional conditional volatility modeling with missing data: inference and application to energy commodities
arxiv-2310-00356.creator: Abdelbasset Djeniah, Mohamed Chaouch, Amina Angelika Bouchentouf
arxiv-2310-00356.description: Abstract . This paper explores the nonparametric estimation of the volatility component in a heteroscedastic scalar-on-function regression model, where the underlying discrete-time process is ergodic and subject to a missing-at-random mechanism. We first propose a simplified estimator for the regression and volatility operators, constructed solely from the observed data.

arxiv-2310-03447.title: FLAIM: AIM-based Synthetic Data Generation in the Federated Setting Conference: Proceedings of the 30th ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining; August 25–29, 2024; Barcelona, Spain Proceedings of the 30th ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining (KDD ’24), A
arxiv-2310-03447.creator: Samuel Maddock, Graham Cormode, Carsten Maple
arxiv-2310-03447.description: Abstract . Preserving individual privacy while enabling collaborative data sharing is crucial for organizations. Synthetic data generation is one solution, producing artificial data that mirrors the statistical properties of private data. While numerous techniques have been devised under differential privacy, they predominantly assume data is centralized. However, data is often distributed across multiple clients in a federated manner.

arxiv-2404-06578.title: A flexible quantum data bus
arxiv-2404-06578.creator: Julia Freund 1 , Alexander Pirker 1 and Wolfgang Dür 1
arxiv-2404-06578.description: Abstract We consider multi-path routing of entanglement in quantum networks, where a pre-prepared multipartite entangled 2D cluster state serves as a resource to perform different tasks on demand. We show how to achieve parallel connections between multiple, freely chosen groups of parties by performing appropriate local measurements among diagonal paths, which preserves the entanglement structure of the remaining state.

arxiv-2407-08210.title: Chiral dynamics in soft triaxial nuclei Journal: Physics Letters B
arxiv-2407-08210.creator: B. Li, P.W. Zhao, J. Meng
arxiv-2407-08210.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by B. Li, P.W. Zhao, J. Meng. The chirality in soft triaxial nuclei is investigated for the first time with the time-dependent and tilted axis cranking covariant density functional theories on a three-dimensional space lattice in a microscopic and self-consistent way. Taking the puzzling chiral nucleus 106 Ag as an example, the experimental energies of the observed nearly degenerate bands are well reproduced without any free parameters beyond the well-defined density functional.

arxiv-2511-19528.creator: Rushuai Yang, Zhiyuan Feng, Tianxiang Zhang, Kaixin Wang, Chuheng Zhang, Li Zhao, Xiu Su, Yi Chen, Jiang Bian
arxiv-2511-19528.description: Abstract Scaling vision-language-action (VLA) model pre-training requires large volumes of diverse, high-quality manipulation trajectories. Most current data is obtained via human teleoperation, which is expensive and difficult to scale. Reinforcement learning (RL) methods learn useful skills through autonomous exploration, making them a viable approach for generating data.
